overview_description.description:
Humu is a human resource company that leverages science and machine learning. Its technology builds applies the findings of decades of research to help anyone grow into a better leader, manager, or teammate.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States.

about_short_description.short_description: Humu is a human resource company that affects work through science and machine learning.

product.name: Employee Engagement Surveys
product.description: Surveys designed to identify areas for improvement within an organization, mapping goals to specific behaviors for actionable insights.

product.name: Nudges
product.description: Personalized, science-backed recommendations delivered to employees to promote behavior change and improve work habits.

product.name: Manager Diagnostics
product.description: Analytical tools that assess manager performance, identifying strengths and areas for improvement to enhance team success.

product.name: Pulse Surveys
product.description: Frequent, short surveys that provide immediate insights into employee sentiment and engagement, supporting timely interventions.

product.name: People Insights Platform
product.description: A platform leveraging AI to tailor recommendations and deliver them in the flow of work, aiming to improve employee experience.

product.name: Operationalizing Behavioral Frameworks
product.description: A service that translates company values into specific actions, driving improvement at every organizational level.
